mapper.sql: code.CMM_SN, code.CMM_PARENT_SN, code.CMM_CD, code.CMM_NM, code.CMM_EXPLN, code.CMM_SORT_NO, code.CMM_USE_YN
mapper.select: SELECT FROM CMM_CODE code WHERE code.CMM_CD = #{groupCode} AND code.CMM_PARENT_SN IS NULL AND code.CMM_USE_YN = 'Y' LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM CMM_CODE code WHERE code.CMM_CD = #{groupCode} AND code.CMM_PARENT_SN IS NULL AND code.CMM_USE_YN = 'Y' LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM CMM_CODE code JOIN CMM_CODE parent ON parent.CMM_SN = code.CMM_PARENT_SN WHERE parent.CMM_CD = #{groupCode} AND parent.CMM_USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY code.CMM_SORT_NO, code.CMM_SN
SELECT FROM CMM_CODE code JOIN CMM_CODE parent ON parent.CMM_SN = code.CMM_PARENT_SN WHERE parent.CMM_CD = #{groupCode} AND parent.CMM_USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY code.CMM_SORT_NO, code.CMM_SN FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM CMM_CODE code JOIN CMM_CODE parent ON parent.CMM_SN = code.CMM_PARENT_SN WHERE code.CMM_SN = #{bidUnitSn} AND parent.CMM_CD = #{groupCode} AND parent.CMM_USE_YN = 'Y' FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CMM_CODE code JOIN CMM_CODE parent ON parent.CMM_SN = code.CMM_PARENT_SN WHERE parent.CMM_CD = #{groupCode} AND parent.CMM_USE_YN = 'Y' AND code.CMM_USE_YN = 'Y'
SELECT MAX(code.CMM_SORT_NO) FROM CMM_CODE code JOIN CMM_CODE parent ON parent.CMM_SN = code.CMM_PARENT_SN WHERE parent.CMM_CD = #{groupCode} AND parent.CMM_USE_YN = 'Y'
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(CMM_CD, 5) AS UNSIGNED)), 0) FROM CMM_CODE WHERE CMM_CD REGEXP CONCAT('^', #{codePrefix}, '[0-9]{4}$')
mapper.update: UPDATE CMM_CODE code JOIN CMM_CODE parent ON parent.CMM_SN = code.CMM_PARENT_SN SET code.CMM_NM = #{code.name}, code.CMM_EXPLN = #{code.description}, code.CMM_SORT_NO = #{code.sortNo}, code.CMM_USE_YN = #{code.useYn}, code.CMM_UPDT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, code.CMM_UPDT_ID = #{actorId} WHERE code.CMM_SN = #{code.cmmSn} AND parent.CMM_CD = #{groupCode} AND parent.CMM_USE_YN = 'Y'
